parts.title: Wet Footprints
parts.hook: A night nurse's doorbell camera pings at 3:12 and shows a hooded figure on her porch.
parts.cliff: The footprints cross the dry porch and stop at her front door; none lead away.
parts.reveals: The figure returns every night and leaves wet footprints, and the recordings carry tomorrow's date.

parts.title: Her Own Handwriting
parts.hook: Mara tapes a note to her door and the next recording shows an answer on it.
parts.cliff: The answer is written in her own handwriting.
parts.reveals: The recordings come from tomorrow and someone can answer her from there.
parts.recap: A night nurse's doorbell camera records a hooded figure from tomorrow.

parts.title: The Porch
parts.hook: Mara drives home to stand where the figure stands.
parts.cliff: A second figure steps out of her open front door and reaches for the bell.
parts.reveals: The figures take turns waiting on the porch for the next one.
parts.recap: A night nurse's recordings come from tomorrow and the replies are in her handwriting.

arc_payoff: Part 3 shows why the figure always faces away: it is waiting for the next version of Mara, which pays off part 1.
